glosses: bible (a comprehensive manual that describes something)

examples.text: Ningún libro se lee tanto como la Biblia.
examples.en: No other book is read as widely as the Bible.
What does the Bible say about this?

examples.text: Tom lee la Biblia todos los días.
examples.en: Tom reads the Bible every day.

examples.text: Esta es una cita de la Biblia.
examples.en: This is a quote from the Bible.
